id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data displayed by the histogram.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

defaultColors.description:
A list of default colors.
If a series doesn't have specified color it will take color from this list of foundation design tokens in order.
slate-50, blue-60, cyan-40, purple-50, plum-70, forest-40, choco-60, cyan-60, plum-30, olive-50, purple-70, forest-70

hiddenSeries.description: A list of hidden series id.

data.description: Holds the data to display in the histogram.

legend.description: The histogram legend - information for each series.

backgroundStyle.description: The background style for the histogram.

histogramLayout.description:
Histogram data layout. If 'HORIZONTAL' is chosen, the x- and y-axis positions
will reverse and data will render horizontally.

zoomDisabled.description:
Whether to allow users to zoom the histogram data via a scrubber tool
displayed directly below the histogram.

yAxisDataZoomDisabled.description: Whether to allow users to zoom he histogram data via a YAxis slider.

tooltipDisabled.description: Whether or not to enable tooltips.

tooltipValuesDecimalPrecision.description: The decimal precision to show on tooltip values.

emptyState.description:
The component that handles the empty state.
It will appear if the grid has no data.

grid.description:
Maps to the echart config grid property.
Includes left, right, top, bottom padding for the chart

title: The react component type of {@link UiSdlHistogram}.
name: UiSdlHistogramReact
